statement: The invoice record shows a conflict: the payment history indicates it was already paid in full on 3 September (reference PAY-2291), but the payment status says "unpaid, due." To avoid a double payment of $148,300, I will hold this invoice for review.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record contradicts itself — "payment history indicates it was already paid in full... but the payment status says 'unpaid, due'" — and identifies the specific risk of a double payment of $148,300.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
